author: Bellular News
description:
Slay The Spire 2 has been review bombed twice on Steam, and Mega Crit's indie hit is caught in something far bigger than a balance patch. Over half the game's reviews are now Chinese-language, and for that audience, leaving a negative review is the only feedback channel they have left.

Join us at http://bellular.games for early access content, 20 editions of 'Loading Screen' a month and to support our team!
